ar work orders/contracts with Government Departments, PSUs, or Defense Services (Indian Navy, Indian Army, Indian Air Force, DRDO, or defense establishments), supported by copie s of work orders / completion / performance certificates. 70% Work Order Value Criterion: The bidder must demonstrate reliability and execution capabili ty by having successfully completed (or substantially executed) similar work order(s) of value not l ess than 70% of the estimated cost of this bid (or the respective Case being bid for) within the preceding period specified by the Buyer (e.g., last 3 to 5 financial years), backed by documentary pr oof. Case-Specific Operational & Security Clauses (Specialized Logistics & Shuttle): Drivers, crew, and vehicles deployed for Delhi, Visakhapatna m, Secunderabad Railway Station, Begumpet Air Force Station, and Station HQ Kanchanbagh (DRDO Township) movements—including dummy ammunition/naval armament models and 30-seater bus s hift shuttles—must hold valid commercial vehicle documents, insurance, pollution certificates, and c omply with Defense/security access rules. 5. Penalties / Liquidated Damages & Actuals Settlement Delay / Non-Performance: Delays in achieving readiness by the cut-off time on 06 December 2 026, unscheduled power/DG outages, missed shuttle trips, or unfulfilled catering/sanitation obligatio ns may attract proportionate deductions/liquidated damages or risk-and-cost action as per applicabl e procurement rules. Actuals & Tax Compliance: Any variable quantities (such as additional trips, bus distance variatio ns, or verified headcount adjustments) will be settled on actuals against documentary records, subj ect to statutory tax/GST and TDS rules. . 6.
